meta.tldr:
Aider 0.86.0 brings comprehensive updates to model support and command usability. All GPT-5 models are now supported, expanding the range of advanced AI capabilities available for code generation and assistance. Grok-4 is also now accessible via `xai/grok-4` and `openrouter/x-ai/grok-4` model names, and the `gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17` model has been added, along with `openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2`, providing developers with more choices for their AI coding workflows.

Usability improvements have been made to existing commands. The `/clear` command now provides a confirmation message, "All chat history cleared.", ensuring users know the action was successful. The `/undo` command's output has been refined to show only the first line of each commit message, significantly improving readability when reviewing changes. Additionally, the `/model` command, when called without arguments, will now display model announcements, keeping users informed about new or updated models.

Several important fixes are included in this release. An issue where new settings for an existing model failed to replace old ones has been resolved, ensuring model configurations are correctly applied. Analytics have been updated to support the latest PostHog SDK event-capture API, improving data collection reliability. Dependencies have also been bumped to `litellm==1.75.0`, bringing the latest upstream improvements and fixes. This release primarily focuses on expanding model compatibility and enhancing user experience through clearer command feedback and bug fixes, making it a recommended upgrade for all users.
